summary: Observed 2026-11-02 (FS-GG/.github#5240): /tmp on fdev is a 16 GB tmpfs shared by every lane; it filled (about 15k entries, 9.5 GB; fifteen browser-smoke mktemp trees of about 232 MB each and a 725 MB fsgg-gate-engine cache were the bulk) and caused 38 spurious SDD test failures while many browser smokes ran and the quiet-host probe did not admit for 60 minutes. Delivered on routine/5240-fdev-host-hygiene (see the cited files at the cited revision; merge and install are separate effects): (1) scripts/fdev-lane-capacity.py holds when at least 2 headless Chromium MAIN processes are active (argv[0] Chromium binary, --headless, --remote-debugging-pipe|port, no --type=; renderer/GPU/zygote/crashpad children and node/timeout launchers do not count; --browser-hold-at, 0 disables) and when /tmp has under 3 GiB free (--min-tmp-gib, --tmp-path), JSON browsers.count/pids and tmp_free_gib. (2) deployment/fdev-chromium/fdev-chromium-env is now the repository source of the wrapper (it was only ~/.local/bin; the earlier record environment/fdev-headless-chromium says it is not in Git, which this supersedes in fact but not by digest) and defaults TMPDIR to $HOME/.cache/fsgg-tmp unless set; the default is capped at 32 bytes because a Unix socket path is at most 107 bytes and harness trees nest under it (fsgg-sdd-tests-<pid>-<32 hex>); --print-tmpdir serves .NET runs. (3) scripts/fdev-tmp-cleanup.py is dry-run unless --apply and removes only known names (fsgg-sdd-tests-<pid>-*, fsgg-sdd-<hex>, fsgg-ai-*/fsgg-resolver-/fsgg-cli-tests-cache-sandbox-<hex>, fsgg-gate-* except the reusable fsgg-gate-engine cache, playwright profile/artifacts, org.chromium.Chromium.*, and tmp.* only with driver/run-smoke.mjs) whose owner is dead (PID absent, or no live process references the path via cmdline, environ, cwd, fd, maps or /proc/net/unix) and idle over 1 h by newest mtime, with O_NOFOLLOW directory-fd removal that never follows a symlink or crosses a mount; it refuses to delete when the process table is unreadable. Hourly user timer templates (minute 37) and install.py tmp-cleanup and chromium-env effects ship in source; Root installs after merge. Limits: a dry run on the real host listed 1093 of 1115 matched entries (3.5 GiB) removable and removed nothing; the probe samples, it does not reserve; lanes still need TMPDIR set to the disk path for the pressure to drop at the source.
title: fdev host hygiene: /tmp is a shared 16 GB tmpfs, so hold on browser count and /tmp headroom, use a short disk TMPDIR, and sweep only dead harness dirs
